findings.summary: All seven spec deliverables satisfied. Versioned schema (deploy/contract/application-declaration.v1.schema.json) covers identity, artifact ref+immutable commit, command, working_directory, required_environment, health.command, rollback ref+commit. Two declarations exist (deep-research runnable, chatgroup-daemon declaration-only with placeholder 00..0 commit). runPreflight (src/preflight.ts:202) is deterministic and read-only: validates schema, known application, immutable commit format (40-hex lowercase), artifact/working-directory existence, required-environment presence, executable command availability, health-command syntax, each with stable error_code and nonzero exit, in order, before any deploy action. No deploy branch exists in runner; preflight code uses only fs.readFileSync/existsSync/accessSync(X_OK) for executable resolution -- no writes, exec, spawn, fetch, or git mutation. --preflight-only emits resolved immutable commit and stable sha256 declaration digest. Raw green/red stdout+stderr fixtures (test/fixtures/preflight/*.stdout.txt / *.stderr.txt) are acceptance evidence: GREEN = status=PASS, application=deep-research, commit c76594d5f9e45a557b56044d585419a30a3113a8, digest sha256:a1d647fb22d40c88ed58b128bb95870fb813c14fc389024e51e6903158f4a8d5; RED = nonzero exit, status=FAIL, error_code=REQUIRED_ENV_MISSING, no phase:deploy/effects marker. c1-preflight.test.ts drives real CLI entrypoint via execFileSync(vite-node src/preflight-entry.ts) -- does not mock runner. deploy/README.md section 5 states deployment alignment proof (declaration commit == checked-out artifact commit; deploy only from merged remote main via git pull --ff-only; production checkout never a dev/verification location). docs/deploy.md semantics unchanged; pinned test (d1-deploy-config.test.ts E7) remains consistent. No chatgroup-daemon app-specific deploy behavior implemented. No product file outside .dev-dispatch/ altered by review materialization seal.

Implement handoff verification record (.dev-dispatch/handoffs/e156b85b-7f37-5bcd-b416-3104d4d1378d/implement.json) shows broad npm test had counts {failed:2, passed:791, total:793} with exit_code 1. Out of scope for C1 acceptance: run-config.json scopes C1 acceptance test command to test/c1-preflight.test.ts, and smoke:cas passed 1/1. Two broader-suite failures unrelated to C1 deliverables and do not affect GREEN/RED preflight acceptance evidence. Recorded for transparency; not a rejection ground under approved spec.
